derivedFrom: the rules in section 7 and section 17, not from a run. Each horizon is recomputed in the suite from the bars after the listing and the plan the listing stored, and the base rate is recomputed over every name-night rather than over the rows where a reason fired. The committed fixture holds one night per name and its listings sit on the last stored session, so nothing has matured: that is the state the expectation is about, and it is asserted as not yet matured rather than as a blank or a zero. The setup outcomes 8.1 added cannot be reached over the fixture's own listings, which have no session after them, so the cases below are worked by hand from one plan and read by the suite from this file rather than written into the test. The first of them is also stored through the filler, on a constructed listing dated on the fixture's last session: filled once with nothing after it, and again once its closes are stored on the exchange sessions that follow, which is the row a setup maturing on a later night is written to. The break-even cases below are worked the same way, from the plan's own three prices rather than from a run, and they include section 13's own tranche so the figure the document states is the figure the code produces. A setup scored after a split or dividend has restated its closes, an outcome kept once it is decided, and a setup that reaches its target only after the cap are worked by hand the same way, each from the rule rather than from a run, because no fixture night has a session after its listings, let alone a restatement after one.

rules.immature: outcome null, which reads as not yet matured rather than as a blank or a zero
rules.unresolved: a value rather than a null, so it is counted in its own column and never in a rate
rules.stopBeforeTarget: a session that closed through both was stopped out before it could reach anything
rules.baseRatePopulation: every name-night in the window, not the rows where a reason fired
rules.baseRateForSetup: null, because target before stop is a question about a plan and a name with no plan has no answer to it
rules.entry: a setup starts on the first close at or below its entry zone's top edge, the listing night's own close included, and only inside the plan's own range: at or above its stop and at or below its target, a plan with no entry zone taking its whole range as the zone
rules.neverEntered: a target reached before that close, and a setup still unentered at the cap: its own value and its own column, never a win and never in a rate
rules.stopBeforeEntry: a close at or below the zone's top edge that is also through the stop is entered and stopped on that session, because a fall through the whole plan is a trade that happened
rules.capFromTheListing: the 63 sessions are counted from the listing night and not from the entry, since the plan being scored is the one stored that night
rules.returnFromTheEntry: the setup horizon's return is the move from the close it was entered at to the close it resolved on, and null for a setup nobody entered
rules.breakEven: risk over risk plus reward, as a percentage, where risk is the fall from the close the setup was entered at to the stop and reward is the rise from it to the first traded target, so the denominator is the plan's whole range whichever side of it the entry landed on
rules.breakEvenPopulation: present exactly where the setup horizon's return is, being every outcome whose entry close is known, and absent on a setup nobody entered, on one that entered and stopped on a single session, and on a row that has not matured
rules.breakEvenIsNotTheLadders: the ladder's plan arithmetic states its own break-even as a fraction from the entry zone's midpoint and is never stored; this one is a percentage from the entry close and is stored, because it is set against a share written as a percentage
rules.decidedIsFinal: a horizon's outcome once written, being a win, a loss, never entered or unresolved, is never written again, and a matured five or twenty-one session return with it; only a row not yet matured is filled on a later night, and the base rate beside a decided row is the one figure that moves
rules.restatement: a setup still in play is scored with its stop, its target and its entry zone's top edge multiplied by the listing session's stored close over its raw close, which is one on the night the listing is written and is the provider's adjustment since
rules.listingCloseGone: a listing whose close the store no longer holds has nothing its horizons are measured from, so it is handed no sessions and its open rows stay not yet matured
rules.entryFromTheStoredPlan: the filler hands the entry rule the zone's top edge from the plan the listing stored, and not its bottom edge, and the listing night's own close from the bar store, so each case the rule is worked over is what the filler stores for a listing carrying that plan and those closes

constructed.note: one plan, and the cases the entry rule is derived over, each walked by hand: the zone runs from 95 to a top edge of 101, the stop 90 and the first traded target 110, and closes run one session apart from 2026-01-02.

cases.case: entered on the listing night and reached
the target reached from above the zone, which the price never returns to
entered later, when the price comes back to the zone, and then stopped
one session through the zone and the stop together, which is a fill and a stop

pastTheCap.case: entered on the listing night, inside the zone and short of the target for the whole cap, and at the target seven sessions after it

maturedOnALaterNight.note: the first case above, stored through the filler: filled on the night it was listed, with no session after it, its setup row carries nothing; filled again once its closes are stored on the exchange sessions after the listing, the same row carries the case's outcome, the session its resolving close is stored on, its return and its bar
maturedOnALaterNight.case: entered on the listing night and reached

breakEven.note: the bar each plan set for itself, worked by hand from three prices. The first is section 13's own first tranche, whose figures the document states; the next three are the plan the cases above use, entered at three different prices; the last two are the ends of the rule, where the entry sits on the stop and on the target.

cases.case: section 13's first tranche, which the document works out in prose
the constructed plan, entered on the listing night at 100
the same plan entered lower, at 99, which risks less and stands to gain more
a distant target, which the plan may be right rarely and still come out even
the entry on the stop, which risks nothing and has to be right never
the entry on the target, which stands to gain nothing and has to be right always

outsideTheRange.case: an entry zone whose top edge sits above the plan's own target, listed between the two, which the target has already passed
a plan with no entry zone, listed below its own stop and entered when a close comes back inside its range
a plan with no entry zone, listed above its own target

breakEven.outsideTheRangeNote: an entry is admitted only inside the plan's own range, from its stop to the lower of its entry zone's top edge and its target, and a plan with no entry zone takes its whole range as the zone. So no entry sits where the share is undefined, and the return and the bar measured from it are present together and absent together on every plan, including the shapes no stored plan takes.

restated.note: the same plan, listed on 2026-01-01 at a raw close of 100 and scored after the provider restated the store's closes. `listedAt` and `closes` are the adjusted closes as the store now holds them, `rawListedAt` and `rawCloses` what traded, and the restatement is the listing session's close over its raw close. `withoutTheRestatement` is what the plan at its stored prices gives over the same closes, stated so each case is shown to separate the two.

cases.case: a dividend restates the listing session and both sessions after it by 0.99, and the target is reached at the restated price
a two-for-one split halves the listing session and both sessions after it, and the target is reached at the halved price

a dividend goes ex between the two sessions after the listing, restating the listing session and the first by 0.99 and leaving the ex-date as it traded, which closes below the stop at its stored price and above it restated

swing.note: 12.7: the swing filter's rows scored on their own plan, derived from section 17's two rows and the decision that the swing filter's setups are scored on the swing trade's own plan from the listing close. Every swing filter row carrying a plan, being every row whose setup found a band, gets one row on each swing horizon and a row carrying none gets none; on the fixture's night no session follows the night, so each is written not yet matured. How many rows carry a plan is read off the replay's gate rows and not stated here.
